context: Tests whether the push-notifications skill routes a local-only reminder to focused scheduling guidance without adding remote or extension infrastructure.

checklist.name: Calendar semantics
checklist.description: Uses UNCalendarNotificationTrigger and defines wall-clock, time-zone, or daylight-saving behavior for a daily 8:30 AM reminder.

checklist.name: Stable request ownership
checklist.description: Uses a stable request identifier so edit replaces the intended pending request and disable removes the owned pending and appropriate delivered notification.

checklist.name: Authorization behavior
checklist.description: Checks current settings, requests visible authorization in context, and preserves in-app reminder state if notification presentation is unavailable.

checklist.name: Verification
checklist.description: Checks next trigger date, pending requests, edit/disable behavior, localization, and relevant time changes.

checklist.name: Scope boundary
checklist.description: Does not add APNs registration, provider infrastructure, notification extensions, or Live Activity handling.
